triggers: commit type with ! suffix (e.g. feat!, fix!)
breaking change to public API or shared-types used by multiple apps
new module or feature folder under apps/
refactor: internal change without API change
docs:, chore:, test:, ci:, style: with no production code impact
marketplace-only metadata with no functional change

sharedPackagePolicy: When packages/shared-types or packages/shared-utils changes with API impact, bump the package version and consider minor bump for dependent apps
prePushPolicy: Run bump-versions before push; commit version updates with message chore(release): bump <name> to <version>
